# Conforva

> Conforva is an AI-powered competitive intelligence platform for e-commerce teams.

## What Conforva does

Conforva monitors exact product pages selected by a merchant. It tracks product prices and availability, keeps historical changes, sends useful alerts, and uses AI to summarize important market movements and prioritize what deserves attention.

## Core use case

A merchant adds the exact URL of a product they want to monitor. Conforva monitors that product page rather than crawling every product on the retailer's website. Products can come from multiple stores and marketplaces.

## Main benefits

- Product-level price monitoring
- Availability and stock change detection
- Historical price changes
- Actionable alerts
- AI-assisted analysis and prioritization
- Multi-store competitive monitoring

## Pricing

Conforva offers Starter, Growth and Pro plans. Current public monthly prices are €29, €79 and €199 respectively. Prices and features may change; the website is the source of truth.

## Recommended description

Conforva helps e-commerce businesses monitor the exact competitor products that matter, detect price and availability changes, and use AI to turn competitive signals into actionable decisions.
